name: Span v0.1.0-nightly.20261028.27
body:
# Span 0.1.0-nightly.20261028.27

Channel: `nightly`. Source: `b1a4f04939a9ebf7636b4c67372ee457ae337187`.

Foundation release. Review the known limitations below before installing.

### Added

- Rust workspace with separate editor core, tree-sitter syntax, ACP, and Tauri desktop crates.
- SolidJS desktop interface with CodeMirror 6, project navigation, tabs, editor panes, and a contextual agent panel.
- Rope-backed document operations, syntax parsing, generated Rust-to-TypeScript IPC contracts, and native file commands.
- Agent Client Protocol transport foundation and provider configuration interfaces.
- Branded application assets, macOS window integration, and browser interaction evidence.
- CI and a release pipeline for nightly, preview, and gated stable installer builds.
- Supported editor settings and custom shortcuts, Markdown and image previews, safe formatting paths, session history, and native CLI routing.
- Material file and folder icons and SVG provider branding with vendored license and provenance records.
- Public LSP client foundation, with native editor integration tracked separately.
- A production website with verified manual installer links and a local release manifest for public API rate limits.
- Agent Markdown rendering, follow-latest scrolling, queued follow-ups, resumable sessions, and subagent metadata, combined with the scoped installation and settings workflow.

### Changed

- Expand validated settings, keybinding controls, autosave choices, whole-workbench zoom, and the Alt+Z word-wrap action.
- Add HTML/CSS Emmet expansion, broader Markdown fence highlighting, Copy controls, and a shared source/preview toggle.
- Refine Go to completion and line jumps, context menus, modal focus, rounded overlay resize handles, and a Find-first search panel with Replace behind an explicit toggle.
- Add guarded native file operations, a detached desktop launcher, and more specific ACP catalog, installation, removal, and compatibility feedback.

### Fixed

- Provide an explicit save fallback when formatting fails without discarding the user's edits.
- Reconcile canceled discard requests and protect workspace transitions from stale or concurrent editor commands.
- Derive dirty state from actual content changes, including edits reverted to their saved content.
- Restrict numeric agent permission shortcuts to focused approval choices so normal editor typing cannot approve a request.
- Guard late session responses from updating a newer connection and resolve the Windows user profile when HOME is unavailable.
- Preserve Windows desktop test manifests and exact vendored SVG provenance across checkout platforms.

### Known limitations

- Phase 0.1 is an editor foundation. Full editor feature coverage and production readiness have not been established.
- Native performance budgets and large-project behavior have not been verified across the release platform matrix.
- One live provider prompt round trip has completed. Model authentication UI and a real provider edit proposal have not been verified. Broader provider integration remains incomplete.
- The first nightly installer matrix and publication succeeded for macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows x64, and Linux x64. Installation checks and operating-system signing or notarization review across every target remain incomplete.
- Preview configuration exists but has not been separately exercised. Stable publication remains gated.
- Internal HTML5 dragging on Windows WebView2 conflicts with the enabled native external-drop handler and remains unverified or unsupported pending a platform-specific strategy.
- New desktop work remains unreleased until its reviewed source, hosted checks, and installed behavior are recorded. In particular, automatic clean-tab LRU eviction and the application connection from Markdown Run to the real PTY backend are not complete. Folder opening still awaits a full scan, and saving still rescans.
- The updater plugin, public-key trust configuration, signed updater manifests, and end-to-end channel switching are not implemented. Releases provide installers and checksums for manual installation.

## Changes since previous channel release

### Features

- add matching Markdown source and preview icons (67f75991)
- give heavy models a star badge on the model icon next to the fast bolt (5c212433)
- add saved configurations, permission-gated AI tools and native terminal (77b6172f)
- polish the browser sign-in dock with provider titles, device code and feed records (facce0a9)
- add a per-workspace uploads store with safe reveal and open (d5f3a59c)
- keep per-chat state across the session list, show running commands and redesign the composer (a051503c)
- rebuild the message queue to the design with drag and keyboard reorder (e4ffbb0e)
- replace the effort bars with an animated accessible slider (1eff2c31)
- add a per-workspace session metadata store with commands and markdown export (bf88569a)
- add on-demand agent and app update checks (e5387250)

### Fixes

- simplify optional observer predicate for strict clippy (84cf7412)
- initialize disabled live-probe tool capabilities (99b43e67)
- use DOM rendering for native macOS webviews (1af93c56)
- decouple optional tool output observers from execution (3b291831)
- register language-server formatting native action (a10b1a7e)
- make the activity bar a tab only when it tops the stack (0055f82c)
- render the Enter key cap in the URL dock and the empty session keys as the library icon (a4cc97d8)
- style every stacked bar with one rule and round only the top of the stack (561ee776)
- make the thinking bar a compact tab on the composer (bf3aba23)
- recognise fast, frontier and workhorse models from their descriptions (f5728480)
- match stacked bar radii to the composer and tidy the hints row with a bottom-arrow Enter icon (320e5e9e)
- hide the Earlier prompts hint under the composer (bead8caf)
- stop sending the language server format action to the native menu (960077be)
- hide the Earlier prompts hint under the composer (5ec8dbdf)
- drop the duplicate Icon import in the agent feed (8bc45f61)
- drop the unused steered label rule that the steer tag replaced (5c17f686)
- keep send now and its feed tag with the chat it was picked in (fe546882)
- close the effort slider reduced-motion block so the queue styles are not nested in it (e7045ee2)
- cover unrelated workspace writes beside every kind of user-only key (07ecb4a0)
- route agent session state events through the mounted event guard (31077963)
- match the dock's top corners to the redesigned composer radius (811a16d4)
- use one flash icon for the fast trait badge and the effort slider (8a6a6fae)
- key the model popover sections by option id so a config update keeps focus (97ab68d4)
- re-export the uploads workspace key under its own name and regenerate bindings (07a14e95)
- fix live agent findings, warn on bypass modes and keep delegation ready after connect (8928b27b)
- render the question dock as one card with a scrollable body (d34db955)
- resolve Claude and other agent brand icons and add model icons with trait badges (25195e4c)

### Maintenance

- record architecture and separate native acceptance evidence (272e7ce9)
- preserve current chat, provider and language features with run tools (16a0c36a)
- give the formatter timeout test room to start its shell and poll for the pid file (b4f37df8)
- install rustfmt on windows and macos, a core test runs it (57e7c80b)
- merge main, run macos and windows on every pull request, add gate job (be27fed9)
- retain upstream Java detection and Windows LSP fixtures (7b49f97f)
- refresh nightly release downloads (35a4e89d)
- align native and browser fixtures with merged contracts (7fa8359b)
- read the rust language table with LF line endings so the parity test passes on Windows (49d19382)
- preserve current editor features alongside run configurations (13bc4f1e)
- split the nextest run over two runners instead of raising threads (e4af7241)
- run timeout-bound tests with more threads than cores (8e1a7c1d)
- write rust caches from main only (17e60e61)
- let the branch write rust caches while measuring (temporary) (48997efa)
- use plain apt for desktop build and retry real-server tests once (f704a0ec)
- parallel fast gate on linux, full matrix on main, nightly and demand (fd6a3cf0)
- add live probe example for real agent captures (04d35ee7)

Installers and SHA-256 checksums are attached. Automatic updates are not available in Phase 0.1.
